title: 디지털 갈대 정원 · 붉은 태양
purpose: Minimal sun-color revision of the original AI concept; not a Roblox runtime screenshot
prompt: Edit the supplied original pixel-art concept with ONE small localized change only: a RED SUN. Preserve the exact image composition, all golden reeds, the warm wooden boardwalk, the little warm pavilions, the violet/peach sky and pixel clouds, the TWO broken dark rhombus sculptures with cyan edges, the scattered cubes, the mountains, and the water/reflections. In the open sky near the far-right horizon, add a clearly readable muted CRIMSON RED sunset disk, approximately 5 percent of image width in diameter, with its bottom edge slightly hidden behind the distant mountain ridge. It should be a modest red sun belonging naturally to this unchanged warm dreamlike scene. Match the existing crisp pixel-art/dithering style. Do not make the sun enormous. Do not add a monolith, thorns, chrome, anatomy, fog, buildings, new objects, text or blackwork forms. No darkening, no global color grade, no red wash, no new light on the foreground, no changed water or reflection. The only changed pixels should be the sun's compact disk and its immediate edge. This is a precise minimal edit of the provided image, not a new composition. Output the same landscape aspect ratio.
referenceTreatment: Edited only the previously generated original concept. The user's external reference artwork is not an edit target and is not included in the repository.
